meta.title: Our Businesses | AZAFCO International
meta.description: AZAFCO International's business portfolio: seafood and aquaculture at the core, alongside agriculture, livestock and other investment activities.

hero.title: A diversified portfolio with a clear core
hero.intro: Our activities span seafood, agriculture, livestock and other investments. Seafood remains the primary focus of our business and of our export offer.

allocation.title: How our activities fit together
allocation.intro: One corporate brand. Seafood leads; the other activities sit alongside it.
allocation.core_text: Fish farming, processing, packing and export for commercial buyers.

seafood.title: Seafood & Aquaculture
seafood.p1: Our primary business, and the most visible part of our operations and trading relationships: fish farming activities, processing, packing and export to commercial buyers.
seafood.p2: Importers, distributors and foodservice buyers can review species, processing and quality information, then send a specification-based request.

others.title: Other activities in the portfolio
others.intro: These activities are part of AZAFCO International. To keep this page factual, we publish operating details only once they have been approved.
others.agri_text: The company's portfolio includes farmland and activities in fruit and vegetable production. Crop details and seasonal capacity are published once the data is approved.
others.livestock_text: Our activities include livestock farming. Its operating scope, products and figures will be presented once its profile is ready.
others.invest_text: We believe in building productive, diversified businesses. Projects and investments are disclosed in line with our corporate communication policy.

partner.title: New business partnerships
partner.intro: To discuss sector cooperation or investment, send a corporate enquiry from your company email. Fish supply requests go to the export team.
